objective: 15 working technology assets, not 15 permanent hypotheses. Each candidate must reach TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY (20-criterion finish line) or be moved to the cemetery.

manufacturing_pipeline.description: The 14-stage candidate factory pipeline (R304–R308). Produces executable models. Does NOT produce finished technology packages.

completion_pipeline.description: The R309 completion pipeline. Maps each manufactured candidate to the 20-criterion finish line. Runs AFTER manufacturing; does NOT replace it.

stages.name: Mechanism specification
stages.completion_test: Document exists, defines the mechanism (not just the intervention), references the model.

stages.name: Architecture / design
stages.completion_test: Documents exist, define components, geometry, control law, and engineering tolerances.

stages.name: Working reference implementation
stages.completion_test: Code runs end-to-end. Outputs are reproducible from seed. README exists.
stages.constitutional_basis: Article XVI (never confuse implementation with proof)

stages.name: Strongest comparator
stages.completion_test: Best publicly known alternative explicitly named and cited. No strawman. Comparator model runs and produces output.

stages.name: Attack suite
stages.completion_test: At least 3 hostile attacks: functional-equivalence, prior-art, mechanism-failure. Each attack runs and produces a verdict.
stages.constitutional_basis: Article VIII (certification must attack itself), Article XVII (every control must have an attempted bypass)

stages.name: Pre-registered falsification criterion
stages.completion_test: Quantitative threshold declared BEFORE the executed result was observed. Timestamped. Frozen.
stages.constitutional_basis: Article VIII (certification must attack itself), Article XXVII (no threshold invention)

stages.name: Executed result
stages.completion_test: Actual measurement preserved. Seeds, configs, raw outputs all stored. Timestamped AFTER preregistration.

stages.name: Independent verification / cross-check
stages.completion_test: Second implementation from STANDARD_SIMULATOR_REGISTRY (or justified alternative). Frozen tolerance declared BEFORE comparison. Result: MODEL_VERIFIED or MODEL_DISAGREEMENT with root-cause analysis.

stages.name: Known limitations
stages.completion_test: Document explicitly states what the model does not capture, what was approximated, and where the uncertainty lives.
stages.constitutional_basis: Article XV (coder must disclose inconvenient results)

stages.name: Reproduction package
stages.completion_test: A competent third party can reproduce the executed result without our assistance. All dependencies, seeds, data, and steps documented.

stages.name: Economic model with sourced inputs
stages.completion_test: Current cost, intervention cost, deployment cost, development cost — each tied to a public or buyer-specific source. No decorative price tags.
stages.constitutional_basis: Article I (evidence precedes assertion), Article XXXVI §8

stages.name: Counterfactual value calculation
stages.completion_test: Quantifies the buyer's annual value of adopting this vs. the strongest comparator. Model is reproducible. Inputs are evidence-tier labeled (MODELLED / PUBLICLY_VERIFIED / BUYER_VERIFIED).

stages.name: Buyer integration path
stages.completion_test: Concrete steps a buyer would take to integrate, validate, and deploy. Specific to a buyer archetype, not generic.

stages.name: Transaction scope / options
stages.completion_test: What is being offered, at what rights level, with what exclusivity and field-of-use boundaries. Same evidence at every price tier; rights differentiate price, not evidence.
stages.constitutional_basis: R275 STRATEGIC SHIFT (rights differentiate price, not evidence)

stages.name: Complete TTP
stages.completion_test: All folders and files exist. manifest.json links each artifact by path and SHA-256. No missing files.

stages.name: Prior-art landscape
stages.completion_test: Closest published art cited. What each reference teaches is summarized. Search provenance preserved (queries → databases → results → exclusions, per R274).
stages.constitutional_basis: Article XI (history is evidence too), R274 (negative-search provenance required)

stages.name: Argument for technical differentiation
stages.completion_test: States what our system adds, framed as a technical effect (not a patent claim). Explicitly tied to the mechanism specification (C01).

stages.name: Known third-party claims / patents that could matter
stages.completion_test: Includes threats against us, not just favorable art. Disclosure is mandatory.
stages.constitutional_basis: Article XV (coder must disclose inconvenient results)

stages.name: Trade-secret / know-how components
stages.completion_test: Parts of the package that are not in the public artifacts but are necessary to practice the invention are explicitly listed.

stages.name: Explicit legal-diligence questions for buyer counsel
stages.completion_test: Open questions, not advocacy. Designed for buyer's counsel to examine, not for us to render a patentability verdict.
stages.constitutional_basis: Article XXXVI §9 (buyer's counsel handles legal diligence)

completion_pipeline.completion_finish_state_requires: All 20 criteria (C01–C20) have output_artifacts present and audited.

repair_pipeline.description: For candidates in FAIL or CONDITIONAL state. Finite budget. Not endless iteration.
repair_pipeline.diagnosis_required_separation: Mechanism failure (Article XXIX §1) vs. implementation failure (Article XXIX §2). The repair path differs.

documented_examples.P-05_R308: tautology → mechanism invalid → real PK → fail → no value (Article XXIX §1: mechanism failure, not implementation bug)
documented_examples.P-06_historical: r⁴ physical constraint → V1+V2 both fail → cemetery (mechanism infeasible, no repair attempted)
documented_examples.P-08_historical: CSF energy harvesting 0.62 nW → physics measurement falsifies → cemetery (mechanism infeasible)

replacement_permitted_only_when: Credible replacement exists in existing-candidate reservoir
Replacement is not merely invented to inflate count
portfolio_discipline.R308_state: 15 active + 2 cemetery (P-06 r⁴ constraint, P-08 CSF energy physics)
portfolio_discipline.R309_target: Maintain 15 active; replace failures from reservoir where credible; cemetery grows only when no credible replacement exists

phase_plan.description: Per CEO directive R309 §10. Prioritize by remaining completion cost × technical uncertainty, not by inventing new products.

phase_A.name: Reference implementation
phase_A.goal: P-01 reaches TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY first. Becomes the template for all subsequent completions.

notes.P-16: MCX + PyTissueOptics cross-check REQUIRED (Article XXXVI §6, §7). Resolve R308 diffusion-vs-Kubelka–Munk 60–70% disagreement before completion.
notes.P-15: Energy budget physics must be cross-checked against P-08 cemetery entry (CSF harvesting 0.62 nW falsified). P-15 partial recovery in R297 must be re-verified independently.

phase_C.name: Remaining 9 candidates
phase_C.goal: Each candidate either reaches TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY, is repaired within budget, or is replaced from the reservoir.

special_handling.P-03: R308 admits 'passes, but model may be too simple to show the difference.' This is NOT a pass — it is an uninformative experiment. Next experiment must create conditions under which the floor mechanism actually distinguishes itself from the comparator. Otherwise P-03 does not progress.
special_handling.P-05: R308 FAIL: tautology → mechanism invalid. Repair path: real PK model. If real-PK model still fails the pre-registered criterion, P-05 → cemetery. No V3.
special_handling.P-10: R308 FAIL (5.04s vs 5s limit). Diagnose: mechanism failure (phase-change physics too slow) vs. implementation failure (parameters wrong). If mechanism failure, P-10 → cemetery. If implementation failure, one repair attempt.
special_handling.P-14: R308 FAIL (16.5% vs 30%, estimator noise). Diagnose: mechanism failure (yield matching fundamentally noisy) vs. implementation failure (estimator design). One repair attempt.
special_handling.P-17: R308 FAIL. Biohybrid endothelial monolayer. Diagnose mechanism vs. implementation before any repair attempt.

machine_enforcement.pre_commit_hook: Blocks commits claiming TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY without §5 folder structure and §2 criteria manifest.
machine_enforcement.dashboard_generator: Canonical report (§12) produced from artifacts, not from claims.
machine_enforcement.constitution_loader: Surfaces Article XXXVI before every coding session.
machine_enforcement.violation_handling: False claim of TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY treated as constitutional violation under Article XV (must disclose inconvenient results) and Article XXXI (every correction creates a memory artifact).
